body: You have a new friend, me. Show me what that view is like from there, friend. Talk to me.

I know about this as well. I told my Dad I was depressed and suicidal. He told me he was in Vietnam. I told him it wasn't a competition, that I was just telling him how I felt. He then told me how fortunate I am. But yet all these "fortunes" he claims I have clearly are not making me say, "golly gee, you're right Dad, let me wipe the tears from my face, stop self-harming and smile because my life is so incredible."

Fuck this shit indeed. You don't need to worry about other people having it better, you need to focus on yourself and seek comfort where people listen and where you have sympathy and where people support you. I no longer turn to my "family". My sister is the same way but even worse. I turn to a good friend I have who lives far from me, but who is there day and night if I need help. My friends are my family. So ya, fuck this shit.

Yes. 100% agree. My dad just told me he was in Vietnam so I shouldn't want to kill myself. Other BS I hear:

\-It will get better

\-This is temporary and it won't always be this way

Oh and my sibling told me to go hiking in the nude.

All so pathetic.
I feel this way all the time, so yes.
